technique_name: Design a program that teaches children basic coding principles.
description: The program would be designed to teach children the basic principles of coding in a fun and interactive way. It would introduce them to key concepts such as variables, functions, loops, and logic, as well as help them to develop problem-solving and debugging skills. The program would also give children a chance to practice coding by providing users with guided tutorials and challenges of increasing difficulty.
